text:
Andy Ogles promotes Preventing Forced Abortions Act and calls for Senate action on voter ID
U.S. Representative Andy Ogles, who represents Tennessee's 5th congressional district, posted a series of tweets on July 22, 2026, addressing legislative initiatives and political issues.
In a tweet published at 15:34 UTC, Ogles stated, "No woman should ever be forced to murder a child because of a provision buried in a contract. My Preventing Forced Abortions Act ensures that federal courts cannot enforce these coercive clauses or allow intended parents to withhold promised compensation when a surrogate mother". The message highlights his introduction of the Preventing Forced Abortions Act, which aims to prevent enforcement of contractual clauses that could compel surrogates to undergo abortions or threaten their compensation.
At 15:41 UTC the same day, Ogles acknowledged colleagues and organizations supporting his bill. He wrote, "Thank you, @RepSheriBiggs, @RepBoebert, @RepMaryMiller, @RepBrecheen, and @RepKeithSelf for co-sponsoring. Another thank you to @sbaprolife, @nrlc, @CWforA, @SFLAction, and @CatholicVote for supporting."
Later at 16:40 UTC on July 22, Ogles addressed voter identification legislation and Senate proceedings: "Americans are OWED a good faith debate on voter ID in the Senate. Democrats are COUNTING on the SAVE America Act failing so they can win in November. The people demand a mandate. I stand with them and President Trump. NO RECESS, ONLY ACTION."
Ogles has been an advocate for conservative policies since his election to Congress in 2022 as the representative for Tennessee’s 5th district.
